s0001.literal: Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Arig Temür, was Wuzong's eldest son.
s0001.idiomatic: Emperor Mingzong, posthumous name Yixian Jingxiao, taboo name Arig Temür, was Wuzong's eldest son.

s0002.literal: His mother was Empress Renxian Zhangsheng of the Yiqilie clan.
s0002.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Renxian Zhangsheng of the Yiqilie clan.

s0003.literal: In the third year of Dade under Chengzong, Wuzong was ordered to command troops on the northern frontier; he was born on renzi day in the eleventh month of the fourth year.
s0003.idiomatic: In the third year of Dade under Chengzong, Wuzong was ordered to command troops on the northern frontier; he was born on renzi day in the eleventh month of the fourth year.

s0004.literal: Chengzong died; in the eleventh year, Wuzong entered to succeed to the Great Foundation, installed Renzong as crown prince, and ordered that succession pass to him in order.
s0004.idiomatic: Chengzong died; in the eleventh year, Wuzong entered to succeed to the Great Foundation, installed Renzong as crown prince, and ordered that succession pass to him in order.

s0005.literal: Wuzong died; Renzong ascended the throne; spring of the third year of YanYou, when the Eastern Palace was under deliberation, Chancellor Tiemudie'er, wishing to secure his position and win favor, proposed installing Shidebala as crown prince; together with the empress dowager's favorite minister Shiliemen he slandered him before the two palaces; after long insinuation, the scheme succeeded.
s0005.idiomatic: Wuzong died; Renzong ascended the throne; spring of the third year of YanYou, when the Eastern Palace was under deliberation, Chancellor Tiemudie'er, wishing to secure his position and win favor, proposed installing Shidebala as crown prince; together with the empress dowager's favorite minister Shiliemen he slandered him before the two palaces; after long insinuation, the scheme succeeded.

s0006.literal: Thereupon he was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and sent out to garrison Yunnan.
s0006.idiomatic: Thereupon he was enfeoffed Prince of Zhou and sent out to garrison Yunnan.

s0007.literal: Attendants' Office officials were appointed; Tughluq, remotely invested as central secretariat left grand councillor, Orda the grand minister of husbandry, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Shangjianu, commander of ten-thousands of Mongol troops of Shanbei Liaoyang and other routes Boluo, Hanlin expositor academician Jiaohua, and others were all made attendants; Central Guard elite army commander Tangut and Ministry of War minister Saqan Baduqu were made chamberlains; two deliberators and two recorders were still appointed, and they were dispatched to take up the garrison.
s0007.idiomatic: Attendants' Office officials were appointed; Tughluq, remotely invested as central secretariat left grand councillor, Orda the grand minister of husbandry, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Shangjianu, commander of ten-thousands of Mongol troops of Shanbei Liaoyang and other routes Boluo, Hanlin expositor academician Jiaohua, and others were all made attendants; Central Guard elite army commander Tangut and Ministry of War minister Saqan Baduqu were made chamberlains; 2 deliberators and 2 recorders were still appointed, and they were dispatched to take up the garrison.

s0008.literal: That year, eleventh month of winter, he halted at Yan'an; Tughluq, Shangjianu, Boluo, and Wuzong's old ministers Chiri, Shabuding, Qabarqu, and others all came to meet.
s0008.idiomatic: That year, eleventh month of winter, he halted at Yan'an; Tughluq, Shangjianu, Boluo, and Wuzong's old ministers Chiri, Shabuding, Qabarqu, and others all came to meet.

s0009.literal: Jiaohua plotted, saying, "The realm is our Martial Emperor's realm; the matter of being sent out to garrison was originally not the Supreme One's intent — it came about because those at the ruler's side sowed discord.
s0009.idiomatic: Jiaohua plotted, saying, "The realm is our Martial Emperor's realm; the matter of being sent out to garrison was originally not the Supreme One's intent — it came about because those at the ruler's side sowed discord.

s0010.literal: Please report the reason to the branch secretariat, so that it may be brought to the court's attention — then perhaps the sowing of discord can be blocked; otherwise, unforeseen changes may arise.
s0010.idiomatic: Please report the reason to the branch secretariat, so that it may be brought to the court's attention — then perhaps the sowing of discord can be blocked; otherwise, unforeseen changes may arise.

s0011.literal: " Thereupon with several horsemen he galloped away.
s0011.idiomatic: " Thereupon with several horsemen he galloped away.

s0012.literal: Earlier, Ashan had been grand preceptor; Tiemudie'er seized his post and sent him out as Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor; when Jiaohua and the others arrived, he immediately joined branch secretariat grand councillor Taqachar, branch surveillance censor-in-chief Tulibai, and surveillance vice censor Tughon in fully mobilizing the Guanzhong armies, advancing in separate columns through Tong Pass and Hezhong Prefecture.
s0012.idiomatic: Earlier, Ashan had been grand preceptor; Tiemudie'er seized his post and sent him out as Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor; when Jiaohua and the others arrived, he immediately joined branch secretariat grand councillor Taqachar, branch surveillance censor-in-chief Tulibai, and surveillance vice censor Tughon in fully mobilizing the Guanzhong armies, advancing in separate columns through Tong Pass and Hezhong Prefecture.

s0013.literal: Before long Taqachar and Tughon launched a surprise attack and killed Ashan and Jiaohua at Hezhong; he then went west and reached the Golden Mountain on the northern frontier.
s0013.idiomatic: Before long Taqachar and Tughon launched a surprise attack and killed Ashan and Jiaohua at Hezhong; he then went west and reached the Golden Mountain on the northern frontier.

s0014.literal: Northwestern princes including Cha'atai, hearing he had arrived, all led their followings to submit.
s0014.idiomatic: Northwestern princes including Cha'atai, hearing he had arrived, all led their followings to submit.

s0015.literal: When he reached their territory, he fixed regulations with them: each year they wintered at Jaya'an, summered at Olokoch'a Mountain, and in spring ordered their followers to farm at Yeni; for more than ten years the frontier was tranquil.
s0015.idiomatic: When he reached their territory, he fixed regulations with them: each year they wintered at Jaya'an, summered at Olokoch'a Mountain, and in spring ordered their followers to farm at Yeni; for more than 10 years the frontier was tranquil.

s0016.literal: Seventh year of YanYou, Renzong died; Shidebala succeeded to the throne.
s0016.idiomatic: Seventh year of YanYou, Renzong died; Shidebala succeeded to the throne.

s0017.literal: That year, summer, fourth month, on bingyin day, his son Toghan Temür was born — he who would become Emperor Zhizheng.
s0017.idiomatic: That year, summer, fourth month, on bingyin day, his son Toghan Temür was born — he who would become Emperor Zhizheng.

s0018.literal: Third year of Zhizhi, eighth month, on guihai day, Censor-in-Chief Tieshi and others assassinated Shidebala; Prince of Jin Yesun Temür installed himself as emperor and changed the reign title to Taiding.
s0018.idiomatic: Third year of Zhizhi, eighth month, on guihai day, Censor-in-Chief Tieshi and others assassinated Shidebala; Prince of Jin Yesun Temür installed himself as emperor and changed the reign title to Taiding.

s0019.literal: Fifth month, envoys were dispatched to escort Empress Babusha back from the capital.
s0019.idiomatic: Fifth month, envoys were dispatched to escort Empress Babusha back from the capital.

s0020.literal: Second year, his younger brother Tugh Temür went out to reside at Jiankang as Prince of Huai.
s0020.idiomatic: Second year, his younger brother Tugh Temür went out to reside at Jiankang as Prince of Huai.

s0021.literal: Third year, third month, on guiyou day, his son Yilianzhen Shiraban was born — he who would become Emperor Ningzong.
s0021.idiomatic: Third year, third month, on guiyou day, his son Yilianzhen Shiraban was born — he who would become Emperor Ningzong.

s0022.literal: Year wuchen, seventh month, on gengwu day, Emperor Taiding died at Shangdu; Doresh monopolized power and acted on his own authority; for more than a month no ruler was installed, and court and countryside were anxious and fearful.
s0022.idiomatic: Year wuchen, seventh month, on gengwu day, Emperor Taiding died at Shangdu; Doresh monopolized power and acted on his own authority; for more than a month no ruler was installed, and court and countryside were anxious and fearful.

s0023.literal: At that time associate privy council administrator Yan Temür remained to guard the capital and thereupon plotted to raise righteous action.
s0023.idiomatic: At that time associate privy council administrator Yan Temür remained to guard the capital and thereupon plotted to raise righteous action.

s0024.literal: Eighth month, on jiawu day at dawn, he summoned the hundred officials to assemble at Xingsheng Palace; the troops all bared their blades and proclaimed to the multitude, "The Martial Emperor had two sage sons — filial, brotherly, benevolent, and literary; all under Heaven turn their hearts to them; the Great Foundation lies with them — we must welcome and install them; whoever does not obey shall die!
s0024.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jiawu day at dawn, he summoned the hundred officials to assemble at Xingsheng Palace; the troops all bared their blades and proclaimed to the multitude, "The Martial Emperor had two sage sons — filial, brotherly, benevolent, and literary; all under Heaven turn their hearts to them; the Great Foundation lies with them — we must welcome and install them; whoever does not obey shall die!

s0025.literal: " Thereupon he bound grand councillors Ubaidullah and Barqachar, and central secretariat left vice chancellor Duodu, associate administrator Wang Shixi, and others were thrown into prison.
s0025.idiomatic: " Thereupon he bound grand councillors Ubaidullah and Barqachar, and central secretariat left vice chancellor Duodu, associate administrator Wang Shixi, and others were thrown into prison.

s0026.literal: Yan Temür and Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri firmly held the inner court.
s0026.idiomatic: Yan Temür and Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri firmly held the inner court.

s0027.literal: At that time he was still far away in the desert and could not arrive suddenly; fearing other changes might arise, Yan Temür welcomed his younger brother the Prince of Huai at Jiangling and also proclaimed that envoys had already been dispatched north to welcome him, to reassure the multitude.
s0027.idiomatic: At that time he was still far away in the desert and could not arrive suddenly; fearing other changes might arise, Yan Temür welcomed his younger brother the Prince of Huai at Jiangling and also proclaimed that envoys had already been dispatched north to welcome him, to reassure the multitude.

s0028.literal: He further falsely claimed that envoys dispatched by him had come from the north, saying the Prince of Zhou was marshaling the princes' troops and turning the chariot south — he would arrive within the day.
s0028.idiomatic: He further falsely claimed that envoys dispatched by him had come from the north, saying the Prince of Zhou was marshaling the princes' troops and turning the chariot south — he would arrive within the day.

s0029.literal: On dingsi day the Prince of Huai entered the capital; the hundred officials requested that the Great Foundation be rectified; he firmly declined, saying, "My elder brother is in the north; by seniority and by virtue he should possess all under Heaven.
s0029.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Prince of Huai entered the capital; the hundred officials requested that the Great Foundation be rectified; he firmly declined, saying, "My elder brother is in the north; by seniority and by virtue he should possess all under Heaven.

s0030.literal: If it cannot be avoided, my intent must be made clear and proclaimed within and without.
s0030.idiomatic: If it cannot be avoided, my intent must be made clear and proclaimed within and without.

s0031.literal: " Ninth month, on renshen day, the Prince of Huai ascended the throne — this is Wenzong; the reign title was changed to Tianli, and an edict to the realm said, "We respectfully await our elder brother's arrival, to fulfill our firm intent to yield.
s0031.idiomatic: " Ninth month, on renshen day, the Prince of Huai ascended the throne — this is Wenzong; the reign title was changed to Tianli, and an edict to the realm said, "We respectfully await our elder brother's arrival, to fulfill our firm intent to yield.

s0032.literal: " At that time Doresh was at Shangdu; he installed Emperor Taiding's son as emperor and dispatched troops in separate columns to attack Dadu; meanwhile Prince of Liang Wang Chan, right chancellor Dash Temür, censor-in-chief Niudze, and grand marshal Buqa all encamped their armies at Yulin; Yan Temür with his younger brother Sadun, his son Tangqishi, and others commanded troops to give battle and repeatedly defeated them.
s0032.idiomatic: " At that time Doresh was at Shangdu; he installed Emperor Taiding's son as emperor and dispatched troops in separate columns to attack Dadu; meanwhile Prince of Liang Wang Chan, right chancellor Dash Temür, censor-in-chief Niudze, and grand marshal Buqa all encamped their armies at Yulin; Yan Temür with his younger brother Sadun, his son Tangqishi, and others commanded troops to give battle and repeatedly defeated them.

s0033.literal: The Shangdu troops all fled in rout.
s0033.idiomatic: The Shangdu troops all fled in rout.

s0034.literal: Tenth month, on xinchou day, Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür and marshal Buqa Temür led troops to besiege Shangdu; Doresh thereupon presented the imperial seal and surrendered; the roads between the two capitals were opened at last.
s0034.idiomatic: Tenth month, on xinchou day, Prince of Qi Yolqi Temür and marshal Buqa Temür led troops to besiege Shangdu; Doresh thereupon presented the imperial seal and surrendered; the roads between the two capitals were opened at last.

s0035.literal: Thereupon Wenzong dispatched Hasan and Sadi and others in succession to welcome him; the princes of the northern desert all urged him to return south to the capital, and he thereupon set out from the northern frontier.
s0035.idiomatic: Thereupon Wenzong dispatched Hasan and Sadi and others in succession to welcome him; the princes of the northern desert all urged him to return south to the capital, and he thereupon set out from the northern frontier.

s0036.literal: Princes Cha'atai, frontier marshal Duolienie, commander of ten-thousands Mailü, and others all commanded troops to escort the journey; old ministers Boluo, Shangjianu, and Qabarqu all followed.
s0036.idiomatic: Princes Cha'atai, frontier marshal Duolienie, commander of ten-thousands Mailü, and others all commanded troops to escort the journey; old ministers Boluo, Shangjianu, and Qabarqu all followed.

s0037.literal: Reaching the Golden Mountain, Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor Pobi came to welcome him; Prince Wuning Chechequ and associate privy council administrator Temür Buqa arrived in succession.
s0037.idiomatic: Reaching the Golden Mountain, Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor Pobi came to welcome him; Prince Wuning Chechequ and associate privy council administrator Temür Buqa arrived in succession.

s0038.literal: He thereupon ordered Boluo to proceed to the capital; the people of the two capitals, hearing his envoys had arrived, shouted and danced for joy, saying, "Our Son of Heaven has truly come from the north!
s0038.idiomatic: He thereupon ordered Boluo to proceed to the capital; the people of the two capitals, hearing his envoys had arrived, shouted and danced for joy, saying, "Our Son of Heaven has truly come from the north!

s0039.literal: " Princes and old ministers vied to be first in welcoming and paying court; wherever he passed, crowds gathered.
s0039.idiomatic: " Princes and old ministers vied to be first in welcoming and paying court; wherever he passed, crowds gathered.

s0040.literal: Chihitang 《Collected Essentials of the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries》
s0040.idiomatic: Chihitang 《Collected Essentials of the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries》

s0042.literal: Song Lian, 《History of Yuan》, Volume 31, p.151, note 1
s0042.idiomatic: Song Lian, 《History of Yuan》, Volume 31, p.151, note 1

s0043.literal: First year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.
s0043.idiomatic: First year of Tianli, first month, on yichou day, Wenzong again dispatched central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür to welcome him.

s0044.literal: On yiyou day Sadi and the others arrived and entered to see him at the traveling encampment, urging accession by Wenzong's command.
s0044.idiomatic: On yiyou day Sadi and the others arrived and entered to see him at the traveling encampment, urging accession by Wenzong's command.

s0045.literal: On bingxu day the Emperor ascended the throne north of Helin; the escorting princes and great ministers all entered to congratulate; he thereupon ordered Sadi to dispatch men back to report to the capital.
s0045.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Emperor ascended the throne north of Helin; the escorting princes and great ministers all entered to congratulate; he thereupon ordered Sadi to dispatch men back to report to the capital.

s0046.literal: That month, former Hanlin academician exemplar Budashili arrived with Palace Domestic Service director Sharaban, conveying gold, silver, coins, and silks.
s0046.idiomatic: That month, former Hanlin academician exemplar Budashili arrived with Palace Domestic Service director Sharaban, conveying gold, silver, coins, and silks.

s0047.literal: He dispatched Sadi and the others back to the capital; the Emperor charged them, saying, "My younger brother once perused books and histories — has he lately neglected them?
s0047.idiomatic: He dispatched Sadi and the others back to the capital; the Emperor charged them, saying, "My younger brother once perused books and histories — has he lately neglected them?

s0048.literal: In the leisure of hearing government, he should draw near worthy scholar-officials and discuss historical records, to know the gains and losses of governance through the ages.
s0048.idiomatic: In the leisure of hearing government, he should draw near worthy scholar-officials and discuss historical records, to know the gains and losses of governance through the ages.

s0049.literal: When you reach the capital, you should convey my intent to him."
s0049.idiomatic: When you reach the capital, you should convey my intent to him."

s0050.literal: Second month, on renchen day, Prince Xuanjing Mainu came from the capital to pay court.
s0050.idiomatic: Second month, on renchen day, Prince Xuanjing Mainu came from the capital to pay court.

s0051.literal: On xinchou day the late empress of the Yiqilie clan was posthumously honored as Empress Renxian Zhangsheng.
s0051.idiomatic: On xinchou day the late empress of the Yiqilie clan was posthumously honored as Empress Renxian Zhangsheng.

s0052.literal: That month, Wenzong established the Kui Zhang Pavilion Academy at the capital and dispatched men to memorialize appointment orders; the Emperor approved them all.
s0052.idiomatic: That month, Wenzong established the Kui Zhang Pavilion Academy at the capital and dispatched men to memorialize appointment orders; the Emperor approved them all.

s0053.literal: Third month, on wuwu new moon, he halted at Jegianchaghan.
s0053.idiomatic: Third month, on wuwu new moon, he halted at Jegianchaghan.

s0054.literal: On xinyou day Wenzong dispatched right chancellor Yan Temür to present the imperial seal; surveillance vice censor Ba'irq, privy council administrator Tughqa Temür, and others each led their subordinates to follow.
s0054.idiomatic: On xinyou day Wenzong dispatched right chancellor Yan Temür to present the imperial seal; surveillance vice censor Ba'irq, privy council administrator Tughqa Temür, and others each led their subordinates to follow.

s0055.literal: On renxu day imperial chariots, robes, and the apparel of close attendants were made.
s0055.idiomatic: On renxu day imperial chariots, robes, and the apparel of close attendants were made.

s0056.literal: On bingyin day the Emperor said to central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür, "When I reach Shangdu, the princes of the imperial domains will surely all come to assemble — this is not comparable to an ordinary court audience; Prince Cha'atai now also follows me from afar; the relevant offices' provisions for guests must all be prepared in advance.
s0056.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Emperor said to central secretariat left vice chancellor Yolqi Temür, "When I reach Shangdu, the princes of the imperial domains will surely all come to assemble — this is not comparable to an ordinary court audience; Prince Cha'atai now also follows me from afar; the relevant offices' provisions for guests must all be prepared in advance.

s0057.literal: You should deliberate on this with the secretariat ministers.
s0057.idiomatic: You should deliberate on this with the secretariat ministers.

s0058.literal: " On dinghai day earth rained; there was haze.
s0058.idiomatic: " On dinghai day earth rained; there was haze.

s0059.literal: Fourth month, on guisi day Yan Temür saw the Emperor at the traveling palace and led the hundred officials in presenting the imperial seal; the Emperor praised his merit and made him grand preceptor, still appointing him central secretariat right chancellor, commissioner with the same trappings as the Three Excellencies of an opened princely household, pillar of state of the upper grade, recorder of state military affairs, supervisor of the state history, darughachi, and Prince of Taiping — all as before.
s0059.idiomatic: Fourth month, on guisi day Yan Temür saw the Emperor at the traveling palace and led the hundred officials in presenting the imperial seal; the Emperor praised his merit and made him grand preceptor, still appointing him central secretariat right chancellor, commissioner with the same trappings as the Three Excellencies of an opened princely household, pillar of state of the upper grade, recorder of state military affairs, supervisor of the state history, darughachi, and Prince of Taiping — all as before.

s0060.literal: He again instructed Yan Temür and the others, saying, "Of the hundred officials at the capital whom my younger brother employs, all shall remain as before; you should convey my intent to them.
s0060.idiomatic: He again instructed Yan Temür and the others, saying, "Of the hundred officials at the capital whom my younger brother employs, all shall remain as before; you should convey my intent to them.

s0061.literal: " Yan Temür memorialized, "Your Majesty rules the myriad regions; what the state's great affairs depend upon is only the Central Secretariat, the Privy Council, and the Censorate — suitable men should be chosen to fill them.
s0061.idiomatic: " Yan Temür memorialized, "Your Majesty rules the myriad regions; what the state's great affairs depend upon is only the Central Secretariat, the Privy Council, and the Censorate — suitable men should be chosen to fill them.

s0062.literal: " The Emperor approved his words and made Wuzong's old follower Qabarqu central secretariat grand councillor, former central secretariat grand councillor Bo Temür privy council administrator, and attendant Boluo censor-in-chief.
s0062.idiomatic: " The Emperor approved his words and made Wuzong's old follower Qabarqu central secretariat grand councillor, former central secretariat grand councillor Bo Temür privy council administrator, and attendant Boluo censor-in-chief.

s0063.literal: On jiawu day a traveling privy council was established; Prince Zhaowu and privy council administrator Huosha was put in charge of traveling privy council affairs; Sa Temür, Mainu, and others were made associate traveling privy council administrators.
s0063.idiomatic: On jiawu day a traveling privy council was established; Prince Zhaowu and privy council administrator Huosha was put in charge of traveling privy council affairs; Sa Temür, Mainu, and others were made associate traveling privy council administrators.

s0064.literal: That day the Emperor feasted the princes and great ministers in the traveling hall; Yan Temür, Qabarqu, Bo Temür, Boluo, and others attended.
s0064.idiomatic: That day the Emperor feasted the princes and great ministers in the traveling hall; Yan Temür, Qabarqu, Bo Temür, Boluo, and others attended.

s0065.literal: The Emperor specially charged the censorate officials, saying, "Taizu once admonished his ministers, saying, 'Beautiful women and famous horses — all men delight in them; yet if the heart's inch is once entangled, it can ruin name and virtue.
s0065.idiomatic: The Emperor specially charged the censorate officials, saying, "Taizu once admonished his ministers, saying, 'Beautiful women and famous horses — all men delight in them; yet if the heart's inch is once entangled, it can ruin name and virtue.

s0066.literal: ' You who hold the office of wind and discipline — have you also ever borne this in mind?
s0066.idiomatic: ' You who hold the office of wind and discipline — have you also ever borne this in mind?

s0067.literal: When Shizu first established the Censorate, he first appointed Taqachar and Bentejir to jointly administer its affairs.
s0067.idiomatic: When Shizu first established the Censorate, he first appointed Taqachar and Bentejir to jointly administer its affairs.

s0068.literal: All under Heaven and the state are like a single person's body — the Secretariat is the right hand, the Privy Council the left hand.
s0068.idiomatic: All under Heaven and the state are like a single person's body — the Secretariat is the right hand, the Privy Council the left hand.

s0069.literal: When the left and right hands are ill, one treats them with a good physician — when the Secretariat and Privy Council have faults and omissions, can one fail to treat them through the Censorate?
s0069.idiomatic: When the left and right hands are ill, one treats them with a good physician — when the Secretariat and Privy Council have faults and omissions, can one fail to treat them through the Censorate?

s0070.literal: For all princes and the hundred offices, whoever violates law or oversteps ritual — all alike are to be impeached.
s0070.idiomatic: For all princes and the hundred offices, whoever violates law or oversteps ritual — all alike are to be impeached.

s0071.literal: When wind and discipline are weighty, the greedy and corrupt will fear — as when the axe is heavy, it enters the wood deeply; such is the force of it.
s0071.idiomatic: When wind and discipline are weighty, the greedy and corrupt will fear — as when the axe is heavy, it enters the wood deeply; such is the force of it.

s0072.literal: If I have faults and omissions, you too should report them — I shall not blame you for it.
s0072.idiomatic: If I have faults and omissions, you too should report them — I shall not blame you for it.

s0073.literal: " On yimao day Boluo and others were specially charged to transmit the intent and proclaim to Yan Temür, Badashah, Huosha, Qabarqu, Ba'irq, and others, saying, "Shizu established the Central Secretariat, the Privy Council, the Censorate, and the hundred offices and various bureaus to jointly govern all under Heaven; great and small duties already have fixed regulations.
s0073.idiomatic: " On yimao day Boluo and others were specially charged to transmit the intent and proclaim to Yan Temür, Badashah, Huosha, Qabarqu, Ba'irq, and others, saying, "Shizu established the Central Secretariat, the Privy Council, the Censorate, and the hundred offices and various bureaus to jointly govern all under Heaven; great and small duties already have fixed regulations.

s0074.literal: Shizu ordered court ministers to compile statutes and regulations as law for ten thousand generations.
s0074.idiomatic: Shizu ordered court ministers to compile statutes and regulations as law for ten thousand generations.

s0075.literal: From Chengzong onward, successive sage emperors have none failed to reverently observe the established constitution.
s0075.idiomatic: From Chengzong onward, successive sage emperors have none failed to reverently observe the established constitution.

s0076.literal: I now occupy the seat where Taizu and Shizu dwelt; for all Secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and hundred-office affairs, after consultation and unanimous deliberation, translate what is memorialized and report it to me.
s0076.idiomatic: I now occupy the seat where Taizu and Shizu dwelt; for all Secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and hundred-office affairs, after consultation and unanimous deliberation, translate what is memorialized and report it to me.

s0077.literal: Military affairs of secrecy — the Privy Council should report them immediately; do not delay on account of early or late hour.
s0077.idiomatic: Military affairs of secrecy — the Privy Council should report them immediately; do not delay on account of early or late hour.

s0078.literal: For other affairs, if there is truly something to say, one must first go through the Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate; subordinate hundred offices and ministers of the broad defense must not overstep ranks in submitting requests.
s0078.idiomatic: For other affairs, if there is truly something to say, one must first go through the Secretariat, Privy Council, and Censorate; subordinate hundred offices and ministers of the broad defense must not overstep ranks in submitting requests.

s0079.literal: This should be proclaimed to the various offices, so that all may hear and know.
s0079.idiomatic: This should be proclaimed to the various offices, so that all may hear and know.

s0080.literal: If anyone violates my intent, punishment shall be without pardon.
s0080.idiomatic: If anyone violates my intent, punishment shall be without pardon.

s0081.literal: " On dingyou day Shaanxi branch surveillance censor-in-chief Temür Toq was made Shangdu garrison commissioner.
s0081.idiomatic: " On dingyou day Shaanxi branch surveillance censor-in-chief Temür Toq was made Shangdu garrison commissioner.

s0082.literal: On xinchou day Wenzong established a commandery-general's office at the capital and dispatched envoys to memorialize; censorate and surveillance appointment orders were also submitted — all were approved.
s0082.idiomatic: On xinchou day Wenzong established a commandery-general's office at the capital and dispatched envoys to memorialize; censorate and surveillance appointment orders were also submitted — all were approved.

s0083.literal: On guimao day envoys were dispatched to the capital to select a day; left chancellor Temür Buqa was ordered to perform the proxy announcement of accession at the suburban altars and the altars of soil and grain.
s0083.idiomatic: On guimao day envoys were dispatched to the capital to select a day; left chancellor Temür Buqa was ordered to perform the proxy announcement of accession at the suburban altars and the altars of soil and grain.

s0084.literal: Prince Wuning Chechequ and Qabarqu were dispatched to install Wenzong as crown prince; the Crown Prince's Household was still established and the Office of Stored Blessings abolished; Cheli Temür was made central secretariat grand councillor, Kokejis central secretariat right vice chancellor, Qelai and Jirhalang were both made Gansu branch secretariat grand councillors, Hulatai was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor, and Nohai was made Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor.
s0084.idiomatic: Prince Wuning Chechequ and Qabarqu were dispatched to install Wenzong as crown prince; the Crown Prince's Household was still established and the Office of Stored Blessings abolished; Cheli Temür was made central secretariat grand councillor, Kokejis central secretariat right vice chancellor, Qelai and Jirhalang were both made Gansu branch secretariat grand councillors, Hulatai was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor, and Nohai was made Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor.

s0085.literal: On jiachen day the Central Secretariat was ordered to grant one rank higher to officials who delivered the seal; followers were rewarded with coins and silks.
s0085.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Central Secretariat was ordered to grant one rank higher to officials who delivered the seal; followers were rewarded with coins and silks.

s0086.literal: On yisi day a supervising censor said, "The Lingbei branch secretariat controls one region, its breadth ten thousand li — it is truly the land where Taizu first laid the foundation; the state's root is bound up with it.
s0086.idiomatic: On yisi day a supervising censor said, "The Lingbei branch secretariat controls one region, its breadth ten thousand li — it is truly the land where Taizu first laid the foundation; the state's root is bound up with it.

s0087.literal: The trust reposed in a frontier post — how can it be lightly assigned?
s0087.idiomatic: The trust reposed in a frontier post — how can it be lightly assigned?

s0088.literal: Grand councillor Taqaji was never a meritorious old follower; he slavishly served Doresh, rose abruptly from night guard duty, and was immediately made right vice chancellor, then soon promoted grand councillor; he is already seventy, and his hair and eyes are extremely dim.
s0088.idiomatic: Grand councillor Taqaji was never a meritorious old follower; he slavishly served Doresh, rose abruptly from night guard duty, and was immediately made right vice chancellor, then soon promoted grand councillor; he is already 70, and his hair and eyes are extremely dim.

s0089.literal: Left vice chancellor Ma Mou was originally a follower of the Jin residence; he gave his daughter in marriage to Doresh, was introduced as director of waterways, and was then appointed left vice chancellor.
s0089.idiomatic: Left vice chancellor Ma Mou was originally a follower of the Jin residence; he gave his daughter in marriage to Doresh, was introduced as director of waterways, and was then appointed left vice chancellor.

s0090.literal: Section director Luoli was a marketplace petty man; Tughlughunai was a Jin residence guard soldier — neither understands government affairs.
s0090.idiomatic: Section director Luoli was a marketplace petty man; Tughlughunai was a Jin residence guard soldier — neither understands government affairs.

s0091.literal: All should be dismissed and demoted.
s0091.idiomatic: All should be dismissed and demoted.

s0092.literal: " The censorate officials reported this; the Emperor said, "The censor's words are very good — dismiss them all.
s0092.idiomatic: " The censorate officials reported this; the Emperor said, "The censor's words are very good — dismiss them all.

s0093.literal: " He again instructed the censorate officials, saying, "The censor impeached the Lingbei provincial ministers — I greatly commend it.
s0093.idiomatic: " He again instructed the censorate officials, saying, "The censor impeached the Lingbei provincial ministers — I greatly commend it.

s0094.literal: Hereafter, whatever ought to be spoken — do not hold back.
s0094.idiomatic: Hereafter, whatever ought to be spoken — do not hold back.

s0095.literal: If the impeached seek by improper means to appeal, I shall punish them.
s0095.idiomatic: If the impeached seek by improper means to appeal, I shall punish them.

s0096.literal: If the impeachment is not true to fact, do not rashly report it.
s0096.idiomatic: If the impeachment is not true to fact, do not rashly report it.

s0097.literal: " Fifth month, on dingsi new moon, he halted at Doreberjen.
s0097.idiomatic: " Fifth month, on dingsi new moon, he halted at Doreberjen.

s0098.literal: On wuwu day Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri was dispatched back to the capital; Temür was enfeoffed Prince of Baode Commandery.
s0098.idiomatic: On wuwu day Prince of Xi'an Alaqtenashiri was dispatched back to the capital; Temür was enfeoffed Prince of Baode Commandery.

s0099.literal: Escort night guards and others were granted coins and silks in varying amounts.
s0099.idiomatic: Escort night guards and others were granted coins and silks in varying amounts.

s0100.literal: On jiwei day the crown prince dispatched Hanlin academician exemplar Alin Temür to pay court.
s0100.idiomatic: On jiwei day the crown prince dispatched Hanlin academician exemplar Alin Temür to pay court.
